entries.mitigation: Tank each Colossus immediately and clear the summoned wave before the next one compounds the room pressure.
Step out of skull paths; being struck causes heavy damage and knockdown.
Focus the Senche and free a pinned player immediately rather than continuing the general cleave.
Preserve clean floor space and avoid the fungal ground effects entirely.
Move together to the active relic and kill the appropriate Bonefiends on it so their explosions deactivate the relic.
Hold in safe gaps between expanding crystal circles instead of running through the room and creating extra movement errors.

entries.entry_name: Haunting Spectre — Ulfnor and Sabina Cedus
entries.mitigation: Locate and burn Sabina immediately when a player is chained. The trapped player cannot free themselves before Ulfnor reaches them.

entries.entry_name: Orryn Channel — Orryn the Black and Thurvokun
entries.mitigation: Track Orryn's teleports and interrupt every ground channel immediately; assign ranged interrupt coverage if needed.

entries.entry_name: Plague Breath — Orryn the Black and Thurvokun
entries.mitigation: Use Yisareh's Life Ward and execute the assigned stack position when Thurvokun's breath resolves.

entries.entry_name: Terrorizing Tremor — Orzun the Foul-Smelling and Rinaerus the Rancid
entries.mitigation: Preserve the spawned ice spikes and use them as shelter for the lethal snowstorm/tremor sequence.

entries.entry_name: Skeever Summon Channel — Orzun the Foul-Smelling and Rinaerus the Rancid
entries.mitigation: Interrupt Rinaerus when he channels to prevent unnecessary Skeever spawns.
Use the synergy to free a petrified player immediately, before Doylemish finishes the lethal eye beam.
The tank plugs the active ice vent while the group kills Corrupted Leimenids and stays out of the water.
Kill the add type Jorvuld requests immediately so he can prepare the antidote before plague stacks become unmanageable.
The tank deliberately soaks grate poison waves so they do not transfer lethal damage to the group.

entries.entry_name: Fire Cage Beam — Zaan the Scalecaller
entries.mitigation: Rotate players through the beam protecting the caged target; one player should not absorb repeated hits alone.
Use the shield safe zone in normal Veteran. In Hard Mode, preserve and assign the four distinct safe-state mechanics for each poison wave.
